_meta.what: Human-layer pipeline: companies the 1440 Sports team has ALREADY APPROACHED directly. The engine must NOT re-surface these as fresh signals to pitch — they are in-flight by the human layer. This list also calibrates the engine's targeting profile (see 'profile_lessons').
_meta.why: Provided by the MD on 2026-06-16. These are real outreach targets, not engine picks. Recording them (a) prevents duplicate/embarrassing re-pitches, (b) seeds the outcomes loop (approached -> meeting -> deal), and (c) sharpens what 1440 actually goes after.
_meta.rule: Before shipping any new signal, check it is not in this list. If the engine ranks one of these, mark it 'approached' rather than re-briefing it cold.
profile_lessons: 1440 targets a BROADER profile than 'pre-IPO unicorn' — mature PUBLIC companies are in scope (Five9, SLB, nVent, Planet Labs are all public).

Strong INDUSTRIAL / ELECTRICAL / ENERGY / DEEP-TECH lean (Versigent EV-electrical, SLB energy tech, nVent electrical, Planet Labs space/geospatial) — not just B2B SaaS. Electrical/EV-hardware is especially motorsport-native (F1/FE are electronics-intensive).
Born-big spin-offs are a live, prized class (Versigent = the worked example).
Still B2B across the board; deal-capable balance sheets matter more than 'venture-stage' labels.
Action: widen sourcing beyond clean-energy/SaaS startups to include public industrials, electrical/energy/space deep-tech, and fresh spin-offs.
